name: Dubai
heading: Adobe and AI training in Dubai
summary: Classroom and in-company Adobe Creative Cloud and AI training in Dubai, priced in USD, delivered at a hired venue or at your own office.
body_html:
Dubai is a production city. Agencies, studios and post houses around Media City, Internet City and d3 turn work around on short deadlines, retail and e-commerce teams publish a new campaign every fortnight, real estate and hospitality marketing runs on photography, floor plans and video, and government and semi-government communications teams produce in two languages and to a brand manual. That mix changes what people want from a class. Attendees here rarely want an introduction to a discipline; they want to stop doing a specific task badly, and they want to leave with the file, the template or the workflow that fixes it.

Classroom dates in Dubai run at a hired training venue, and because the venue is booked per date rather than held year round, the address, building, parking and access details go out with the joining instructions for that date rather than being published here. The larger share of our Dubai work is private in-company training delivered at your own office, anywhere in the Emirates, where the exercises are rebuilt around your brand, your product photography, your InDesign templates and your own approval process. For a team of roughly five or more that is normally both cheaper and more useful than buying public seats. Courses for the UAE and the wider Gulf are quoted and charged in USD, and organisations can be invoiced against a purchase order.

Scheduling is built around a Monday to Friday working week, so public dates sit midweek and Saturday cohorts are arranged for private groups who cannot release staff on working days. Tell us if you need shorter days during Ramadan and we will schedule around it rather than compress the syllabus. Dubai runs on Gulf Standard Time, UTC+4, which is ninety minutes behind Colombo, so if you mix classroom attendance with our live online dates, a class that starts at 09:00 in Sri Lanka starts at 07:30 for you. Every date on the schedule shows its start and finish time in your own time zone.

Two things are worth sorting before you book. First, corporate laptops in the UAE are often locked down, and Creative Cloud has to be installed by IT rather than by you; the course fee covers the training, not an Adobe licence, so send the requirements to your IT team when you book and use the setup check we run before the first session. Second, if certification is the reason you are training, understand what it is: the Adobe Certified Professional exams are Adobe's, delivered through Certiport at authorised test centres, and the voucher is bought separately. We teach against the published exam objectives and tell you which exam maps to which course, but no provider, including us, awards that certification or can promise you a pass.

Teaching and materials are in English. Classes are small enough that the instructor can look at every screen, you keep the exercise files and the finished projects, the recording is available to you for twelve months, and a live booking includes one free repeat of the same class. If the Dubai date you want is not on the schedule yet, the same course runs live online at times that work from the Gulf, and a good deal of the catalogue is available self-paced for people whose travel makes fixed dates unrealistic.
